newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm at the weekly auction in Mombasa on improved general demand, auction officials said on Monday.
Brighter, medium and lower medium BP1s were 2-6 U.S. cents dearer while Brighter PF1s gained 5-10 cents. Brighter P DUSTs were irregularly dearer and selected lower mediums were also firm.
Selected Fannings and Dusts sold at last levels while BMFs were dearer.
There was improved enquiry from Pakistan while Egypt and Sudan lent support. Britain provided more support.
